historically_traded_population_reconstru.definition: Every in-scope exchange observation that traded in each covered session can be reconstructed from dated official trade files.
historically_traded_population_reconstru.does_not_imply: Complete listed, suspended, inactive, or terminal population.
historically_traded_population_reconstru.evidence: All 12 locked A.8 bhavcopies were retrieved, but full-interval completeness and immutable permitted retention are not established.

historically_listed_population_reconstru.definition: Every security listed in scope at each decision time is present whether or not it traded.
historically_listed_population_reconstru.evidence: A.8 qualified only 3 of 12 dated security-snapshot pairs and found no complete event-ledger alternative.

inactive_security_coverage.definition: Dated population evidence retains non-trading and inactive listings within their applicable intervals.
inactive_security_coverage.does_not_imply: Complete suspension reasons or terminal consideration.
inactive_security_coverage.evidence: Modern A.8 snapshots contain snapshot-only rows, but pre-2024 coverage is unproved.

suspension_history_available.definition: Authoritative dated suspension and resumption events are complete for the covered population and interval.
suspension_history_available.does_not_imply: Permanent delisting or zero economic value.
suspension_history_available.evidence: No complete authoritative suspension ledger has been qualified.

terminal_outcomes_available.definition: Every permanent disappearance has authoritative economic treatment, including cash or successor consideration where applicable.
terminal_outcomes_available.does_not_imply: A final quoted price is delisting consideration.
terminal_outcomes_available.evidence: A.5-A.10 retain unresolved terminal outcomes and explicitly fail delisting coverage.

stable_security_identity_verified.definition: Dated listing, instrument, ISIN, and alias continuity is authoritative and ambiguous mappings remain unresolved.
stable_security_identity_verified.does_not_imply: Issuer-name or ticker similarity is identity evidence.
stable_security_identity_verified.evidence: A.8 identity was complete only in three modern snapshot samples; the historical interval remains unresolved.

promotion_rule: No current status may be promoted by this reconciliation specification.
